onboarding.title: Welcome to Claude Burn Rate
onboarding.intro: Two quick things and you're set. No account needed, everything stays local. Already signed in on another device? Hit Sign in up top and we'll pull your state over.

step1.title: When does your weekly reset?
step1.hint: When your quota resets back to 0.

step2.title: How much have you burned this week?
step2.hint: In percent. Most plans show this in the Claude Code status line.

subtitle.fetching: Pulling your latest values from your private gist.

preWeek.title: Your reset is {days} days away — does that look right?
preWeek.explanation: Claude works on a rolling 7-day window. With your date the week starts on {date}. Until then "time elapsed" is stuck at 0% and the pace looks unfairly red.
preWeek.snap: 📅 Set reset to 7 days from now

exhausted.label: Maxed out
exhausted.message: Quota empty — wait for reset or upgrade your plan.

resetNow.label: Reset live
resetNow.message: Week's over — fresh quota is rolling in.

preWeek.label: Pre-week
preWeek.message: Week hasn't started yet — double-check the reset date.

burn.label: Send it
burn.message: Loads of headroom — floor it, bro!

cruise.label: Chill pace
cruise.message: All in the flow — pace lines up perfectly.

careful.label: Watch it
careful.message: A touch hot — tap the brakes.

save.label: Save mode
save.message: Burning too fast — switch to clever saving now!

tomorrow.exhausted: Quota empty. Chill until reset — or upgrade your plan.
tomorrow.fresh: Fresh week, untouched quota. Full power.
tomorrow.tooEarly: Too early for an honest forecast. Come back in a few hours.
tomorrow.hits100WithLastSafe: If you keep this up: 100% on {day}. {lastSafe} would be your last full-throttle day.
tomorrow.hits100: If you keep this up: 100% on {day}.
tomorrow.safe: At current pace you'll land at {pct}%. Quota will hold comfortably.

snap.title: Set reset to 7 days from now
snap.hint: Snaps your week-end date exactly 7 days into the future.

sync.title: Usage = Time
sync.hint: Sets the usage slider to the currently elapsed time.

newWeek.title: Start new week
newWeek.hint: Sets usage to 0%. Reset date stays unchanged.

share.title: Share burn rate
share.hint: Shares your current state as a text card.

syncNow.title: Sync now
syncNow.hint: Push your current state to your sync gist immediately.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.hint: Delete GitHub token locally. Sync stops; localStorage stays.

signIn.title: Sign in with GitHub
signIn.hint: Enables cross-device sync via private gist (scope: gist).

reset.title: Reset app
reset.hint: Wipes all local data and restarts at onboarding.

reset.title: Reset app?
reset.lead: All local data on this device gets deleted. The app then restarts in onboarding, like your first visit.
reset.warn: You're signed in as @{login}. We'll sign you out. Your sync gist on github.com stays — you can manually delete it there if you want.

install.subline: Homescreen shortcut · works offline · no trackers

ios.title: Add to iPhone
ios.lead: Add Claude Burn Rate to your home screen and it behaves like a real app. Quick access, its own icon, works offline.
ios.step1Text: In Safari, tap the Share icon at the bottom
ios.step2Hint: sometimes a bit further down the list
ios.step3Hint: done — the app sits on your home screen
ios.footnote: Only works in Safari. Chrome on iOS doesn't support this.

toast.rolloverGap: You were away — {weeks} weeks skipped, fresh quota is live.

exhausted.title: Quota empty 🪫
exhausted.subtitle: Weekly Claude quota fully maxed.
exhausted.footnote: Claude Code is paused on your account until then.
exhausted.subFootnote: Reset day {date} at {time} is your refresh line.

account.title: Account
account.deviceLocalOnly: This device shows your local state until the next sync.
account.dirtyNotice: Local changes are about to sync…

quickSet.title: Set usage to {target}%?
quickSet.body: Current value: {current}%. Will be overwritten with {target}%. Sure?

tz.title: Timezone
tz.subtitle: Pick one or use your browser's default.

weekStart.title: When did this week start?
weekStart.subtitle: Moves the current week's start without touching the reset date. Auto behavior comes back on the next rollover.

about.heading: About the app
about.intro: {name} tracks your weekly {claudeLink} quota. Drop in your reset date and current usage, then watch live how much you've got left, what your daily budget looks like at this pace, and whether you'll make it to the weekend. Free.
about.localNote: Local-first. No account required by default, your values only live in your localStorage, no trackers. Want cross-device sync? Sign in with GitHub and your state lands in a private gist on your own GitHub account. Installable as a PWA, straight to your homescreen on mobile.
about.meta: build by you · for you · shroomlife flavor
about.disclaimer: Not an official Anthropic product. Personal hobby project by shroomlife — we're not affiliated with Anthropic, PBC. "Claude" and "Anthropic" are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC.
